Definition: Mattan, the name of a priest of Baal, and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Mattan is the priest of Baal whom the people slew before the altars when Joash was crowned, breaking down the house of Baal in Judah. A later Mattan is the father of Shephatiah, one of the princes who heard Jeremiah's words and wanted him dead.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two Mattans show the two sides of a name: one served a false god and died at his own altar, and the other raised a son who tried to silence God's prophet. A name is not a destiny, but the choices attached to it are.
RelatedPeople: Joash, King of Judah; Jeremiah; Mattan, Priest of Baal
